name: Jeddah Corniche Circuit

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap raceway ways 1007989410, 1359884757, 1257884699, 1359884761, 1359884760, 1359884759, 1359884758, 1359884756, 1359884762 (c) OSM contributors; start line (grid) located on Esri World Imagery
sources.width: published: ~12 m typical street-circuit width, main straight ~16 m, Turn 13 banking ~15 m (section mapping, not measured)
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (https://copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com/), rolling median (+-45 m), samples below 1 m (sea-wall/water pixels) floored at 1 m, robust-median smoothed; seafront site, almost flat
sources.camber: none (30 m DEM cannot resolve crossfall; Turn 13 real banking ~12 deg not represented)
sources.pit: OSM ways 1121870473/1257884704/1257884703 (pit lane west of the start straight)
sources.trim: low-medium downforce: fastest street circuit, long flat-out sections (Baku/Vegas-like)
sources.pitLoss: approximate F1 public previews (~19-21 s; short pit loss)

notes: 27 numbered turns: T1, T13 (banked) and T27 anchored, intermediate turn numbers assigned from curvature peaks and approximate. Turn 13 banking not in cs. No sprint in 2026.
